svg.title: Riju proposes linked source records as overlapping map markers form a comic crowd.
svg.desc: Transparent maps stack into a cluster of conflicting location symbols. At his refurbished terminal, Riju draws a Crosswalk that connects each claim to its original source instead of selecting one map as truth; Ila calls it a bridge.
svg.text: Page 19, panel 5 · Low oblique shot through a stack of transparent maps towards Riju's terminal

text.tspan: Riju proposes the Crosswalk as a layer that links
claims but preserves the source and purpose of each

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
